summary: F6 final regression sweep on 'Magazzino Elios Tech'. Full backend pytest suite: 75 passed + 1 skipped by design (pre-existing test_submit_arrivo_blocks_not_configured — cannot exercise without altering Notion since all 42 items are configured). Added /app/backend/tests/test_f6_regression.py (17 tests) covering every endpoint in scope: GET /api/inventory, /api/inventory/lookup (found/not_found), /api/movimenti (no-month, month=YYYY-MM, invalid, sorted desc), /api/dashboard/kpi (all keys), /api/anomalie, /api/checklist/history, /api/admin/inventory (auth+ok), /api/admin/recipients, /api/admin/notion-exits, plus 3 strict-serial validations on /api/checklist/send (unknown FAKE_SN → 409 'non risulta presente', duplicate FAKE_SN in payload → 409, over-stock A Quantità → 409). NO real writes to Notion. Frontend E2E via Playwright PASSED 8/8: Dashboard shows 4 KPI cards (Stock/Arrivi/Spedizioni/Sotto scorta), Inventario shows both 'A Seriale' (ambra) and 'A Quantità' (grigio) badges, 0 NON CONFIGURATO items (coherent with backend). Arrivi & Spedizioni: scanner-input has autofocus at mount AND regains focus after Enter of unknown code (no page reload). Spedizioni page shows 'Operatore' + 'Cliente' labels as required. Movimenti page loads with month filter (?month=2026-08) — correctly filtered server-side. Anomalie loads. Admin login (admin123) OK; Gestione Prodotti tab counts: Tutti(42) / A Seriale(13) / A Quantità(29) / Non configurati(0).

integration_issues.issue: Fires 2 identical GET /api/movimenti?month=YYYY-MM calls on first mount (likely React StrictMode double-invoke of useEffect in dev). Requirement said '1 sola chiamata'. In production build StrictMode double-invoke does not occur, so this is a dev-only observation. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Response envelope inconsistency across endpoints: /api/inventory returns {items, categories, refreshed_at}, /api/movimenti returns {items, count, month, date_from, date_to}, /api/anomalie returns {items, count}, /api/admin/inventory returns {items}, /api/inventory/lookup returns {status, matched_by, item, code}. All are self-consistent and used correctly by the frontend, but a shared response schema across list endpoints would ease client work. Non-blocking.
server.py is 1183 lines — consider splitting checklist/arrivi/admin/dashboard routers to keep <700 lines each (code quality rule).

F6 strict-serial validations behave correctly: unknown SN → 409 'non risulta presente', duplicate SN in same payload → 409 'inserito più volte', quantity over stock → 409 'Quantità non disponibile'. All three anomaly kinds are logged in /api/anomalie (verified: submit_blocked_serials, shipment_shortage, arrivo_blocked_serials all present).

Notion SSOT confirmed: no MongoDB collection duplicates inventory/stock/movements; PUT /api/admin/inventory/tipo-gestione writes through to Notion Select and invalidates 60s cache (already covered by test_admin_update_tipo_gestione_roundtrip in test_f5_tipo_gestione.py which passed again in this run).

Scanner autofocus is robust: verified via document.activeElement introspection on both /arrivi and /spedizioni; focus returns to data-testid=scanner-input after Enter of unknown SN, no page reload observed.
seed_data_creation: None. Only READ operations on Notion; strict-validation tests used only FAKE_SN which are rejected before any Notion write.
context_for_next_testing_agent: F6 regression fully green. Backend 75/75 passing. If further work needed on 'block if not configured' path, use monkeypatch of notion_service.get_items() to inject a configured=False item (currently skipped because all 42 real Notion items are configured). Roundtrip target for Tipo Gestione flips remains page_id 3b8a9b09-6783-806d-9044-e46bd262075b (Cavo Molex, a_quantita) — always restore in try/finally. Movimenti double-fetch on mount is likely React StrictMode; safe to ignore for prod but if you want to eliminate, wrap the effect with a ref-guard or check REACT_STRICT_MODE.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found in F6 sweep.
